info.title: Gemini Omni Video and Files API
info.summary: Generate, extend, and retrieve videos, plus upload and manage files.
info.description:
Authenticate with an API key as a Bearer token, in the x-goog-api-key header, or in the key query parameter. Create, retrieve, and extend gemini-omni-1.1-flash videos. New videos default to 9:16 portrait, where the official default is 16:9. A new video goes to an account with enough video allowance left; when none has, creation fails with 409 account_unavailable until an allowance resets. A continuation runs in its original conversation while that account can serve; otherwise another account continues from the stored video and returns a new id to continue from.

Explicit 720p is accepted for fresh text/image generation only. Omit resolution for video inputs and previous_interaction_id: those requests inherit their source resolution. The other official resolutions (360p, 1080p, 4k), explicit duration controls, and tasks other than extend are rejected. Extension length is not guaranteed.

Use background=true with store=true to receive an interaction id before completion. URI delivery returns files/{id} on creation or SSE; subsequent GET returns inline video data. Each serving account keeps its 16 newest stored interactions; an older id can no longer be retrieved or continued.

Errors are JSON under error. Read the identifier, such as account_unavailable, from the start of error.message: it may carry a gemini_web_omni: prefix, and a turn answered without a video continues after ': ' with the product's reply. error.code equals the identifier only for request validation errors; otherwise it is absent or a generic class such as internal_server_error. A missing or unknown API key returns 401.

Files support resumable uploads up to 100 MiB, with chunks up to 16 MiB and 256 KiB nonfinal granularity. Upload sessions expire after 24 hours. The session URL authorizes only that upload; keep it private. Generated files can be downloaded; uploaded inputs cannot. Uploads, deletion, and URI output require operator-configured writable storage. Unavailable storage returns a named 503 error.

origin.description: Base origin URL for the proxy API

post.summary: Create a video interaction or extend a prior video.
post.description:
Creates one new turn. Send only the new prompt and media, not the conversation history. The prompt is limited to 8000 characters and the complete request body to 4 MiB; use Files references for larger media.

To extend, provide previous_interaction_id or a video input and generation_config.video_config.task=extend. Keep the same API key and retain the newest returned id. The previous interaction must have completed with a video. A continuation runs in its original conversation while that account can serve; when it cannot, another account continues from the stored video and the returned id continues from there. Extension length is not configurable or guaranteed.

Explicit 720p is supported only for fresh text/image generation. Omit resolution for continuations and video inputs; otherwise the request is rejected with interaction_resolution_inherited.

URI delivery returns a files/{id} reference on creation or SSE and requires writable storage. GET retrieves inline video data. background=true requires store=true and returns an id with in_progress before generation completes. A synchronous turn that is still rendering when its wait ends also returns in_progress with its id. After an uncertain POST, retrieve an assigned id rather than submitting again.

freshPrompt.summary: Fresh video generation from text prompt

value.input: A yellow paper boat floating on calm blue water, static camera.
Continue the same shot smoothly, keeping the paper boat in frame.

extendUploadedVideo.summary: Extend a video after uploading it with the Files API

content.text: Continue the scene from its final frame.

value.input: Origami crane folding itself on wooden desk.
Time-lapse of sunrise over a misty mountain ridge.

200.description: Interaction snapshot. status=completed carries the video in steps[0].content[0] as data, or as uri when delivery=uri. status=in_progress means the video is still rendering; retrieve the id later. An error beside in_progress reports why the latest check could not finish. status=failed carries the error that ended the turn. With stream=true the body is server-sent events.

schema.description: Server-sent events. Each event has event: and id: <interaction_id>:<n> lines, and its JSON data repeats event_type and event_id. A completed turn emits interaction.created (1), step.start (2), step.delta (3, the video content part), step.stop (4), interaction.completed (5, the full interaction), and done (6, data [DONE]). A turn answered without a video emits interaction.failed (2) with status=failed and error, then an error event whose data holds error and the same interaction. A turn still rendering when the wait ends emits only an error event with message interaction_pending_retrieve_receipt and the in_progress interaction; retrieve its id. Comment lines such as : keep-alive may appear. Resume with GET ?stream=true&last_event_id=<interaction_id>:<n>.

400.description: Rejected before generation. unsupported_interaction_request: a field that is unknown (duration included) or of the wrong type, or a body over 4 MiB. interaction_resolution_unsupported: a resolution other than 720p. interaction_resolution_inherited: a resolution with a video input or previous_interaction_id. interaction_task_unsupported: a task other than extend. interaction_extend_requires_source: extend without previous_interaction_id or a video input. interaction_background_requires_store: background=true with store=false. interaction_inline_video_only: response_format.type other than video, or delivery other than inline or uri. interaction_text_input_only: a part type other than text, image, or video. interaction_reference_invalid: a media part with neither uri nor both data and mime_type. interaction_uploaded_reference_unsupported: a uri that is neither files/{id} nor a Google Drive file. omni_prompt_length_invalid: an empty prompt, or one over 8000 characters. omni_invalid_aspect_ratio: an aspect ratio other than 16:9 or 9:16. continuation_identity_mismatch: a previous_interaction_id this API key cannot continue: unknown, created with store=false, evicted, or made with another key.

validation.summary: Request validation: error.code repeats the identifier

continuation.summary: A previous_interaction_id this API key cannot continue

403.description: The product denied the serving account's request, for example web_rpc_denied.

404.description: A files/{id} reference that does not exist for this API key (file_not_found), or a serving account that no longer offers video (account_model_unavailable).

409.description: No account can take the turn now. account_unavailable: no account has enough video allowance left for a new video, or none is ready; retry after an allowance resets. continuation_account_unavailable: the account holding previous_interaction_id cannot serve, and no other account can take the continuation or the previous interaction has no finished video to carry. continuation_not_complete: the previous interaction has not completed with a video. session_busy or session_requires_reconciliation: the serving account could not start the turn; retry later.

422.description: The product answered the turn without a video (no_video_generated). The message continues after ': ' with its reply when it gave one, for example a declined prompt or a spent daily video allowance. Streaming and background turns report this on the interaction instead, as status=failed with error.code=no_video_generated.

502.description: The upstream response could not be read or retrieved.

503.description: Required storage or provider service is unavailable. URI output requires operator-configured writable storage: files_requires_drive_write_oauth without Drive OAuth, files_drive_write_permission_required with read-only Drive access.

get.description: Retrieves an interaction created with the same API key. Retrieval never starts a new generation and stays on the account that holds the interaction. Completed GET responses contain inline base64 video data even when creation requested URI delivery. Set stream=true for events, and last_event_id or the Last-Event-ID header to resume after a cursor.

parameters.name: stream
parameters.description: Stream server-sent events for retrieval or completion replay.

parameters.name: last_event_id
parameters.description: Event cursor to resume SSE replay from (formatted as <interaction_id>:<index>).

parameters.name: Last-Event-ID
parameters.description: Event cursor used when the last_event_id query parameter is absent.

200.description: Interaction snapshot: completed with inline video, in_progress while rendering (an error beside it reports why the latest check could not finish), or failed with error.

schema.description: Replayed or live interaction events when stream=true.

400.description: A malformed event cursor (invalid_interaction_event_id), or a stream value other than true or false.

404.description: No interaction with this id for this API key (interaction_not_found): unknown, malformed, created with store=false, evicted, or made with another key.

409.description: The account holding the interaction is disabled or unavailable (account_disabled, continuation_account_unavailable). Retrieval does not move to another account; retry later.

422.description: The turn ended without a video (no_video_generated), with the product's reply after ': ' when it gave one.

origin.description: Base origin URL for upload endpoints

post.summary: Start a resumable media file upload.
post.description: Starts a resumable upload for a file up to 100 MiB. Declare the total byte size and MIME type in the upload headers. Success returns X-Goog-Upload-URL: send chunks to that exact private URL. The session expires after 24 hours, with nonfinal chunks aligned to the returned 256 KiB granularity. Upload creation requires an API key and operator-configured writable storage; unavailable write authorization returns a named 503 error.

parameters.name: X-Goog-Upload-Protocol
parameters.description: Upload protocol indicator. Must equal resumable.

parameters.name: X-Goog-Upload-Command
parameters.description: Command to run. Must equal start.

parameters.name: X-Goog-Upload-Header-Content-Length
parameters.description: Total length of file in bytes. Maximum limit is 104,857,600 (100 MiB).

parameters.name: X-Goog-Upload-Header-Content-Type
parameters.description: Valid media MIME type of the upload (e.g. video/mp4, image/png).

parameters.name: X-Goog-Upload-File-Name
parameters.description: Optional fallback display name, bounded at 512 runes.

200.description: Resumable session opened. Location provided in X-Goog-Upload-URL header.

X-Goog-Upload-URL.description: Upload destination URL carrying the 24-hour scoped capability token.

X-Goog-Upload-Chunk-Granularity.description: Chunk step size (256 KiB). Intermediate chunks must align to this granularity.

400.description: Malformed protocol headers, negative size, unsupported MIME type, or metadata mismatch.

409.description: A file with the specified custom ID already exists.

503.description: Storage is unavailable or its write authorization is missing.

origin.description: Base origin URL for upload endpoints

post.summary: Transfer chunks, query progress, or finalize an upload.
post.description:
Send chunks up to 16 MiB to the exact session URL returned at creation. Nonfinal chunks must be multiples of 256 KiB. The upload_id capability authenticates this route without an API-key header and always retains the original owner. Do not share it.

Use upload for intermediate bytes, upload,finalize for the final chunk, finalize to finish, and query with an empty body to check the received offset. The supplied offset must match the received byte count. Finalized sessions may be queried until expiry but do not accept more bytes. Deleted or replaced files invalidate their session.

parameters.name: upload_id
parameters.description: Private opaque upload-session capability, valid for 24 hours.

parameters.name: X-Goog-Upload-Offset
parameters.description: Starting byte offset. Must match the exact received byte count on the server.

schema.description: Chunk bytes up to 16 MiB. Must be empty for query and standalone finalize.

200.description: Chunk accepted, status queried, or file finalized.

X-Goog-Upload-Status.description: Status active while in progress; final when completed.

X-Goog-Upload-Size-Received.description: Total count of bytes successfully received so far.

oneOf.description: Empty object returned while upload status remains active.

400.description: Offset mismatch, unaligned chunk size, or body provided on query/finalize.

401.description: Missing, malformed, or invalid upload-session capability.

409.description: Upload already finalized or upload session unavailable.

410.description: Upload capability token has expired (lifetime is 24 hours).

413.description: Chunk exceeds the 16 MiB single-request limit.

502.description: Storage backend transfer or checksum mismatch error.

503.description: Storage is unavailable or its write authorization is missing.

get.summary: List stored files for the authenticated caller.
get.description: Returns a paginated list of files belonging to the authenticated caller scope. Includes both uploaded reference files and generated videos created with delivery=uri.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Maximum number of files to return (between 1 and 100, default 10).

parameters.name: pageToken
parameters.description: Opaque pagination token bound to the caller.

get.summary: Retrieve metadata for a specific file.
get.description: Retrieves metadata for a file owned by the API key. Use the bare file ID in this URL path; SDK methods also accept the returned files/{id} resource name.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: File ID without the files/ prefix.

404.description: File not found, deleted, or owned by another caller.

delete.description: Marks the file for deletion and removes the underlying storage object. Deletion retries are idempotent.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: File ID without the files/ prefix.

404.description: File not found or owned by another caller.

503.description: Storage is unavailable or required write authorization is missing.

get.description:
Streams the binary media bytes of a generated file (created via delivery=uri). The query parameter alt=media is required.

Only files with source=GENERATED and state=ACTIVE can be downloaded. Uploaded input files cannot be downloaded through this endpoint (rejected with HTTP 400 only_generated_files_can_be_downloaded).

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: File ID without the files/ prefix.

parameters.name: alt
parameters.description: Media download specifier. Must equal media.

Content-Type.description: MIME type of the media file.

400.description: Missing alt=media parameter, file state is not ACTIVE, or attempted download of an UPLOADED source file.

404.description: File not found or owned by another caller.

502.description: Storage backend media stream unavailable or size mismatch.

bearerAuth.description: Bearer API key header (Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY).

apiKeyAuth.name: x-goog-api-key
apiKeyAuth.description: Alternative to Bearer authentication for Interactions, upload creation, and ordinary Files operations.

apiKeyQuery.name: key
apiKeyQuery.description: API key in the key query parameter, as in the official REST examples. Prefer a header: query strings are more likely to be logged.

uploadIdAuth.name: upload_id
uploadIdAuth.description: Private 24-hour upload-session capability returned in X-Goog-Upload-URL. No API-key header is required on this session route; an API key does not replace the capability.

model.description: Target model. Only gemini-omni-1.1-flash is served by this endpoint.

input.description: Prompt text, list of direct input parts, or an official SDK user_input wrapper.

oneOf.description: Plain text prompt, bounded at 8000 runes.

previous_interaction_id.description: Id of a completed, stored interaction created with the same API key. Its conversation continues on the account that holds it while that account can serve; otherwise another account continues from its stored video, and the returned id belongs there.

store.description: Retain the turn for later retrieval and extension. Each serving account keeps its 16 newest stored interactions. Background requests require store=true.

background.description: Asynchronous execution flag. When true, returns immediately with status=in_progress and the interaction id. Requires store=true.

stream.description: Stream server-sent events for turn progress.

InputItem.description: An input element: either a direct media/text part or an SDK user_input step wrapper.

mime_type.description: Media MIME type. Required when data is provided.

data.description: Base64-encoded media bytes without data URL prefix.

uri.description: Supported Drive URI or Files API reference (files/{id}).

UserInputStep.description: Wrapper structure emitted by google-genai 2.24.0 containing turn parts.

task.description: Only extend is accepted, with previous_interaction_id or a video input. The other official tasks (text_to_video, image_to_video, reference_to_video, edit) return interaction_task_unsupported. Duration cannot be configured or requested.

ResponseFormat.description: Output formatting controls. Unlisted settings remain unsupported.

delivery.description: inline returns base64 video data. uri requires writable storage and returns files/{id} in creation/SSE output. GET interactions returns inline data in either case.

aspect_ratio.description: Framing orientation. The default 9:16 yields 720x1280 portrait, unlike the official 16:9 default. Set 16:9 for 1280x720 landscape. Other ratios return omni_invalid_aspect_ratio. Retain the ratio when extending.

resolution.description: 720p is supported for fresh text/image generation only. Omit resolution with video inputs or previous_interaction_id; those requests inherit their source resolution and otherwise return interaction_resolution_inherited. The other official values (360p, 1080p, 4k) return interaction_resolution_unsupported.

account.description: Optional diagnostic identifier. Do not use it to construct requests.

status.description: in_progress: still rendering; retrieve the id later. completed: the video is in steps. failed: error says why the turn ended.

steps.description: One model_output step holding the video once completed, empty otherwise. user_input and thought steps are not returned.

data.description: Base64-encoded video bytes. Omitted when URI delivery is selected on creation.

uri.description: Resource identifier (files/{id}) delivered when response_format.delivery=uri is set.

InteractionError.description: Why a failed turn ended, or beside in_progress why the latest check could not finish.

message.description: The code, followed by ': ' and the product's reply when it gave one.

name.description: Canonical resource identifier formatted as files/{id}.

sizeBytes.description: Total size in bytes formatted as decimal string.

updateTime.description: RFC3339 last update timestamp in UTC.

downloadUri.description: Relative download endpoint path (/v1beta/files/{id}:download?alt=media). Present only for GENERATED media files.

state.description: Lifecycle state of the stored file.

source.description: Source origin of file: UPLOADED by caller or GENERATED by video interactions.

name.description: Optional custom resource name formatted as files/{id}.

nextPageToken.description: Pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

GeneralError.description: Error body. The identifier starts error.message, possibly after a gemini_web_omni: prefix; error.code equals it only for request validation errors. Authentication failures return error as a string.
